name: pulse-health
description: Pulse Health patient portal: Angular app, React port, and a mock HTTP API

scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:angular && npm run setup:react && npm run setup:e2e
scripts.setup:api: cd apps/mock-api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip --quiet && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.setup:e2e: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e run setup
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:angular && npm run test:react
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:api && npm --prefix apps/portal-angular run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/portal-react run test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: npm run demo:build && npm run test:e2e:only
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:angular && npm run lint:react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:angular && npm run typecheck:react
scripts.build: npm run build:angular && npm run build:react
scripts.demo: npm run demo:build && npm run demo:serve
